title: Structure of substances - 123 school
heading: Structure of substances
intro: All the data you need is in the question.

questions.question: Which particles are in the nucleus of an atom?
Which particle in an atom has no charge?
What does the atomic number show?

answers.a: The number of neutrons in the nucleus
answers.c: The number of protons and neutrons together
answers.d: The number of protons in the nucleus

questions.question: What does the mass number show?

answers.a: The number of protons plus electrons
answers.d: The number of protons plus neutrons

questions.question: An atom has 11 protons and 12 neutrons. What is the mass number?
An atom has atomic number 17 and mass number 35. How many neutrons does it have?
How many electrons does a neutral atom with 15 protons have?
What is the maximum number of electrons in the second electron shell?
A sodium atom has 11 electrons. What is the electron arrangement across the shells?
A chlorine atom has 17 electrons. What is the electron arrangement across the shells?
An oxygen atom has atomic number 8. How many electrons are in the outer shell?
Why do noble gases hardly react with other substances?
What is an ion?

answers.a: An atom without electrons and protons
answers.b: A charged atom or group of atoms
answers.c: An atom with an extra neutron

questions.question: A sodium atom gives away one electron. Which ion is formed?
A chlorine atom takes up one electron. Which ion is formed?
A magnesium atom (atomic number 12) wants to give away two electrons. Which ion is formed?
Which atoms usually form positive ions?
How many electrons does an S<sup>2−</sup> ion have? Sulfur has atomic number 16.
How many electrons does an Al<sup>3+</sup> ion have? Aluminium has atomic number 13.
What is the formula of the salt that consists of Mg<sup>2+</sup> and Cl<sup>−</sup> ions?
What is the formula of the salt that consists of Ca<sup>2+</sup> and O<sup>2−</sup> ions?
What is the formula of the salt that consists of Al<sup>3+</sup> and O<sup>2−</sup> ions?
What is the formula of the salt that consists of Na<sup>+</sup> and SO<sub>4</sub><sup>2−</sup> ions?
What is the formula of the salt that consists of Ca<sup>2+</sup> and NO<sub>3</sub><sup>−</sup> ions?
What is the name of the salt with formula Na<sub>2</sub>S?
How are the ions in a salt held together?

answers.b: By the attraction between positive and negative ions

questions.question: When does a salt conduct electric current?

answers.c: When it is dissolved or molten

questions.question: Why do salts have a high melting point?

answers.a: The attraction between the ions is strong

questions.question: How is a covalent bond formed?

answers.a: An atom takes up a proton
answers.b: Two metal nuclei attract each other
answers.c: An atom gives up electrons to another atom
answers.d: Atoms share one or more pairs of electrons

questions.question: Between which atoms does a covalent bond usually occur?

answers.b: Between a metal atom and a noble gas atom

questions.question: How many pairs of electrons do the two hydrogen atoms share in an H<sub>2</sub> molecule?
Why do metals conduct electric current?

answers.d: They consist of positive and negative ions that can move

questions.question: Which substance consists of molecules?
Which substance conducts electric current in the solid state?
